The certificate re-enumerates the plan, re-runs the exact k = 1..4 censuses, verifies the hashes and geometry of every output, re-decides the stored hit, fails on any undecided unit, re-runs two batches from scratch (seed 20261001: batches 12 and 47), and then runs the exact lift decision of research/t5_m3_lift/lift.py on the listed set. Completeness rests on the stored outputs and on research/t5q_m2_rank5/batch.py, which regenerates any batch (batch.py K), under the modular assumption every kernel census of the project makes: a member whose image is nonzero over Q(zeta_5) is nonzero modulo 65521. notes: chi(|T5>^2) = 5 (bounds/T5-m2-upper-5.json at the Lean tier and bounds/T5-m2-lower-5.json, re-derived exactly by the k = 1..4 censuses the certificate runs). Every amplitude of |T5> is nonzero, so a rank-5 decomposition of |T5>^3 sliced at the third ququint gives, at each of the five slice values, a decomposition of |T5>^2 with at most five terms; chi(|T5>^2) = 5 forces every slice of every term to be nonzero and the five slices pairwise non-parallel, so each slice is a 5-set with |T5>^2 in its span, and the census lists exactly one such set up to the unitary symmetry group: the lines x + y = c with phase w^(3c x^2 - 3c^2 x), fixed by the group. The coefficient of each line in |T5>^2 is unique, so a lifted term is determined by its slice pattern c(z) and equals the restriction of |T5>^3 to {x + y = c(z)}. research/t5_m3_lift/lift.py decides over Q(zeta_5) with rational arithmetic whether five such pattern vectors are stabilizer states forming a bijection at every z: of the 3,125 patterns, 25 survive the exact prunes (the affine c(z) = c0 + d z, the only ones with a flat support) and none is a stabilizer state, since the phase has the cubic part (1 + d^3) z^3 + 3 d z x^2 - 3 d^2 z^2 x on that plane. Hence chi(|T5>^3) >= 6, and by projection monotonicity chi(|T5>^4) >= 6 (bounds/T5-m4-lower-6.json). No invisible or coincident term arises at exact rank; excluding rank 6 at m = 3 would need them and is not claimed. Controls (research/t5_m3_lift/results/, docs/notes/t5_m3_lift_design.md section 4): the basis of |T5> lifts to exactly the board's five sectors, the ten rank-3 decompositions of |T5> do not lift, planted products |T5>^2 (x) beta are recovered as the only lift, the qutrit T3 and N cells behave as the board says, and random stabilizer states are recognized. With bounds/T5-m3-upper-15.json the cell is 6 <= chi(|T5>^3) <= 15.
